taskNotes: Ogres are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90) at combat level 40; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the task itself, and no extended range.
Ogres are most commonly found in Kandarin.
Along with ogres, Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans, Mogres, Zogres, and Skogres all count towards the task. Jogres do NOT count.
Zogres and Skogres have a lower combat level but can inflict disease, so take caution; brutal arrows work best against them.

Individual variants carry their own access requirements: Mogres need 32 Slayer (and Skippy and the Mogres / Fishing explosives), Ogresses need The Corsair Curse progress or 10 Agility, and Zogres/Skogres need Zogre Flesh Eaters progress.
Players with 41 Magic can use ensouled ogre heads to cast Adept Reanimation and kill reanimated ogres.
The infobox id field is 'No', so this task has no SLAYER_TARGET id (slayerTargetId left null).
recommendedMethod: The best spot is the level 53 ogres west of Yanille, where you can safespot behind the stone wall and/or use a Dragon cannon. Ogres attack with crush, have low Defence, and are 20% weak to earth spells, so any combat style works. Zogres and Skogres at Jiggig require brutal arrows and can inflict disease.
